## What this hub sees

This hub receives **sanitised spans only** — internal attributes (host, SDK, process) are stripped at the OTel Collector before forwarding. What remains is the aviation business context and the `traceparent` that ties it all together.

| Organisation | `service.namespace` | Service | W3C Baggage origin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aeroporto de Lisboa | `aeroporto-de-lisboa` | `dnotam-originator` | `org.icao=LPPT` |
| NAV Portugal | `nav-portugal` | `dnotam-publisher` | — propagated through |
| TAP Air Portugal | `tap-air-portugal` | `dnotam-consumer` | — propagated through |

Query the Federation API for full participant detail:
```
GET http://localhost:18080/v1/federation/traces/{traceId}
```
